name: Elena Marsh
bio: Bought the first duplex in 2014 and sold both sides before the drywall went up. Still walks every site before we bid on it.

photo.alt: Elena Marsh in a cream blouse, arms folded, in front of the illuminated Monterra Developments sign

name: Priya Raman
bio: Runs feasibility and entitlement, and sits through the neighbourhood meetings that decide them. Trained as a landscape architect.

photo.alt: Priya Raman in a navy blazer worn over a cream blouse, arms folded, in front of the illuminated Monterra Developments sign

name: Daniel Okonjo
bio: Twenty years on site, the last nine running our own framing crews. Holds the schedule, and the punch list nobody else wants.

photo.alt: Daniel Okonjo in a navy blazer and open-collared shirt, arms folded, in front of the illuminated Monterra Developments sign

name: Marcus Bell
bio: Sells from drawings, which means he has to believe them first. Takes every buyer from the first walkthrough through to closing.

photo.alt: Marcus Bell in a navy jacket and open-collared shirt, standing in front of the illuminated Monterra Developments sign
